scenario: Without `latest`, a sequence follows all-matches semantics (LTHE.2.5.1): two Door anchors (ts 0, 1) and one Motion follower (ts 5) in the same zone, within the window, give exactly two firings, one per (anchor, follower) pair. The follower's `where` reads the anchor's binding.
rules_ds:
schema Door scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    zone: String mutable
    ts: Time

schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    zone: String mutable
    ts: Time

rule door_then_motion:
    Door d
    then Motion m within 30_s where m.zone == d.zone
->
    log info "motion after door"
